issue_context.title: Hue, turn off transition not respected when turning off light group
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The transition value is not respected when turning a light group off, the lights turn off immediately.
The light group is a "room" defined in the Hue app and imported into HA, since 2021.12. In 2021.11 this was working fine for the group entity.

For single lights or multiple entities, the transition time is respected.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.12.1

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.11.5

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

hue

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/hue/

### Example YAML snippet

The light (group)

```yaml
entity_id: light.woonkamer
supported_color_modes:
  - brightness
color_mode: color_temp
brightness: 91
is_hue_group: true
hue_scenes:
  - Concentreren
  - Energie
  - Ontspannen
  - Nachtlampje
  - Gedimd
  - Helder
  - Lezen
hue_type: room
lights:
  - Woonkamer Groot 2
  - Windlicht
  - Woonkamer Groot 1
  - Woonkamer Klein
icon: mdi:lightbulb-group
friendly_name: Woonkamer
supported_features: 32
```


Service:
```
service: light.turn_off
data:
  transition: 30
target:
  entity_id: light.woonkamer
```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
The logs do not contain any items related to the light or hue.
```


### Additional information

I've seen a few issues (#61631 #61542) that are related to this one, but those are closed already, they also seem to be about individual lights and that seemed to be fixed with #61581
comments:
Hey there @balloob, @marcelveldt, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`hue`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L237) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

Seeing the same issue with Hue light groups. I can get the transition working with the `light.turn_on` service if I provide a `brightness` value. Since `light.turn_off` does not have a brightness parameter, I have not found a workaround for using transitions with Hue light groups.

review_comments: Should we do this with `asyncio.gather` so all commands are sent at once?
That will run us into the bridge limits, already tried it ;-)
